newsitem.title: UK: Barclays extends gain as buyback confirmed.
newsitem.headline: Barclays extends gain as buyback confirmed.

text.p: Shares in Barclays Plc nudged higher in heavy trading on Wednesday after the banking group confirmed that it had bought back 9.21 million of its shares at 1137.27p per share.
Already up 20p before the repurchase was confirmed, the stock was up 23p at 11.45 stg by 1226 GMT, in volume of just over 29 million shares.

Barclays shares rebounded earlier in the session today as the company said it planned to buy back up to 26 million shares. Last week it fell sharply amid profit-taking after yearly results at the low end of expectations.
Dealers pointed out that Barclays had not managed to buy in all the stock it was looking for.
"People will see the repurchase as effectively putting a floor under the stock at around 1137," said one senior market maker. "In the short term at least, it is not going to go below 1137."
Earlier today analysts at Lehman said they raised their rating on Barclays to "outperform" following its recent decline.
By 1241 GMT Barclays shares were up 25-1/2p at 11.47-1/2 stg in volume of 30 million.
